probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
(Currently Amended) A method for analyzing patient data, comprising: receiving a non-transitory computer readable medium containing historical patient data; executing a processor to perform a receiver operating characteristic analysis of the historical patient data for a region of interest on each of a plurality of different subjects; comparing the historical patient data with current patient data to identify patterns; and presenting a visible display graphically depicting a result of the comparison, wherein the comparison is performed using a machine learning algorithm to enhance the accuracy of the preliminary conclusion regarding the medical condition of the patient based on the current patient data.

(Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: accessing a receiver operating characteristic analysis of historical data for the region of interest on each of a plurality of different subjects; identifying a subset of spatial locations in the region of interest where the current patient data is an accurate predictor of the medical condition; comparing the current patient data at the subset of spatial locations to the receiver operating characteristic analysis of the historical data; and graphically expressing a result of said comparing, wherein the identifying step utilizes statistical significance thresholds to refine the subset of spatial locations.
